text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm putting a draft in the console for a 'decision ladder' UI + API for tiered routing + quota enforcement. Goal: let PMs/auth teams declare per-tier routing prefs and quota behaviour without hand-editing JSON.

sam: +1. One big question: do we expose "hard" vs "soft" quotas in the UI, or always soft by default? Hard quotas mean 429s which break apps.

maria: I think default should be soft degrade -> fallback chain. Hard quotas available behind an enterprise toggle. UX: show expected failure modes and sample responses.

jonathan: Telemetry reqs: we need per-tenant metrics for fallback_rate, tokens_consumed_by_variant, latency_p50/p95 per-variant, and a small probe dataset to monitor quality regressions when falling back. Otherwise ops cannot validate.

lee: Also region constraints: some tenants must never fallback to variants that move inference outside their allowed region. Need region_override flag at the rule level.

emily: From product/console POV, can we support bulk-editing of tiers? e.g., copy pro -> enterprise then tweak. And validation: preview the compiled routing decision tree against a sample traffic profile.

sam: Implementation idea (internal API sketch):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "tiered-fallback-v1",
  "tiers": {
    "free": {"quota": 10000, "quota_mode": "soft", "fallback_chain": ["redwood-small-v1","redwood-quant-v1"]},
    "pro": {"quota": 500000, "quota_mode": "soft", "fallback_chain": ["redwood-medium-v1","redwood-quant-v1"]},
    "enterprise": {"quota": null, "quota_mode": "hard_optional", "fallback_chain": ["redwood-large-v1"]}
  },
  "region_overrides": {"eu": {"pro": {"fallback_chain": ["redwood-medium-eu-v1"]}}},
  "grace_window_seconds": 60
}
```

sam: Note: engine should allow a per-request override header (X-Redwood-Force-Variant) for debug/canary. But only permitted for internal/dev tenants.

rafael: API semantics question: PATCH vs PUT. If we allow partial updates we must ensure atomic compilation. I vote PATCH but backend compiles to canonical form and validates before swapping. Also add a preview endpoint: `POST /policies/preview` that returns compiled decisions plus estimated token cost.

maria: Good. Also we need to show expected SLA impact in console when someone flips quota_mode -> hard. A modal: "This will cause 429s for tier X when quota exceeded. Continue?"

jonathan: For telemetry: add a metric 'fallback_quality_regressions' that ties model outputs to evals. If regression rises > 2% after a rollout, auto-rollback the policy for that tenant or flag for review.

opsbot: deploy-bot: policy-service:deploy queued (#4521). Canary group: 2% enterprise, 5% pro for 1h then evaluate.

emily: UX action: I'll mock a 'decision ladder' panel with drag-drop fallback chain and per-tier quota sliders. Also add an "audit preview" that shows last 7 days of tokens and a recommended grace_window.

lee: Edge case: rate-limited tenants (burst credits). Need to allow burst_credit rules that can be consumed before fallback kicks in.

sam: Also important: logs must include which rule fired + compiled rule_id + matched variant. Makes debugging 10x easier.

maria: Action items: 1) sam + jonathan to finalize compiled policy schema and telemetry fields. 2) emily to prototype UI with preview modal. 3) rafael to draft API preview + patch semantics. 4) lee to write region_override auth checks. I'll track in the doc. :thumbsup:

rafael: one more: add CLI preview: `redwoodctl policies preview --tenant t123 --payload sample.json` returns expected variant and cost estimate.

maria: perfect — thanks all. I'll drop the draft JSON into the repo and ping for PR review.
